text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, lactulose 10 g/15 mL 30 mL is not on FDA's drug shortage list. Corvale General holds 222 units with 9.5 used per day (23.4 days on hand). Corvale Lakeside holds 35 units with 1.8 used per day (19.1 days on hand).

Why (FDA record): The product label for NDC 00116400511 names Xttrium Laboratories, Inc. (FEI 3008436464) as the registered manufacturing plant. FDA inspected that plant on 2025-06-18 and classified it OAI, with the classification known on 2025-09-16. FDA's shortage list does not include lactulose as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory provides approximately 19 to 23 days of supply across sites. No shortage is declared by FDA. Supply continuity depends on verifying availability from alternate distributors not currently on the shortage list.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer verifies current stock and lead times from APOZEAL PHARMACEUTICALS INC. (needs: buyer approval).
2. Buyer verifies current stock and lead times from Actavis Pharma, Inc. (needs: buyer approval).
3. Buyer verifies current stock and lead times from Atlantic Biologicals Corp. (needs: buyer approval).
4. Buyer verifies current stock and lead times from Bajaj Medical, LLC (needs: buyer approval).
5. Buyer verifies current stock and lead times from Chartwell Governmental & Specialty RX, LLC (needs: buyer approval).

Not recommended: No allocation changes or clinical substitutions at this time.
